# ---------------- ARC LAMP (arm curves toward +x) ----------------
def arc_mesh(name, material, r=0.011, seg=28, ring=8):
    import bmesh
    pts = [(0,0,1.20),(0,0,1.55),(0.06,0,1.82),(0.28,0,1.98),(0.62,0,2.03),(0.95,0,1.94)]
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name+'_mesh')
    bm = bmesh.new(); bm.from_mesh(me)
    # build tube manually
    rings = []
    n = len(pts)
    for i,p in enumerate(pts):
        if i==0: d = mathutils.Vector(pts[1])-mathutils.Vector(pts[0])
        elif i==n-1: d = mathutils.Vector(pts[-1])-mathutils.Vector(pts[-2])
        else: d = mathutils.Vector(pts[i+1])-mathutils.Vector(pts[i-1])
        d.normalize()
        t1 = d.cross(mathutils.Vector((0,1,0)))
        if t1.length < 1e-4: t1 = mathutils.Vector((1,0,0))
        t1.normalize(); t2 = d.cross(t1); t2.normalize()
        rv = []
        for k in range(ring):
            a = 2*math.pi*k/ring
            off = t1*(r*math.cos(a)) + t2*(r*math.sin(a))
            rv.append(bm.verts.new(mathutils.Vector(p)+off))
        rings.append(rv)
    for i in range(n-1):
        for k in range(ring):
            k2 = (k+1)%ring
            bm.faces.new((rings[i][k],rings[i][k2],rings[i+1][k2],rings[i+1][k]))
    bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name,me)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    me.materials.append(material)
    return o

import mathutils
def add_cam(name, pos, look, up, fovx_deg=39.6):
    cam = bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
    cam.lens_unit = 'FOV'
    cam.angle = math.radians(fovx_deg)
    cam.sensor_fit = 'HORIZONTAL'
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cam)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    pos_v = mathutils.Vector(pos)
    f = mathutils.Vector(look).normalized()
    upv = mathutils.Vector(up).normalized()
    r = f.cross(upv).normalized()
    u = r.cross(f).normalized()
    M = mathutils.Matrix(((r[0],u[0],-f[0],pos_v[0]),
                          (r[1],u[1],-f[1],pos_v[1]),
                          (r[2],u[2],-f[2],pos_v[2]),
                          (0,0,0,1)))
    o.matrix_world = M
    return o
